title: Cross-product foreign keys to Organization must set related_name='+'
answers: Why is test_model_crossing_uses.py failing when adding a relation to Organization?
How should product models link to posthog.Organization?
What is the convention for reverse accessors on core models across product boundaries?
body:
Models in product directories that reference core models such as posthog.Organization must set related_name='+'.
This convention prevents adding reverse relationship accessors to core models across product boundaries.
If omitted, the automated boundary test test_model_crossing_uses.py fails in CI.
Enforced on relations like products/feature_flags/backend/models/organization_feature_flags_config.py:OrganizationFeatureFlagsConfig.organization.
applies: Django models in products/ referencing core models like posthog.Organization
says: Pull request verification fails when connecting a new product model to organizations
Automated build checks fail after adding organization links to feature settings
Connect new feature records to organizations without triggering boundary check errors
Organization relation on our new table causes repository boundary test failures
